authorship: Explicit literal DOM and raw childNodes paths authored from independent native fixture data and source presentation rules before runtime. No candidate/native/WASM/browser result was executed or converted into expected data.

notation.root: The arrays are childNodes of the one actual mounted host; not HTML parsed by a candidate.
notation.roles: Bind initial objects once using literal paths, assert nodeType/tag/static attrs/data independently, retain actual references. Native role aliases bind separately through guarded source seed paths; production DOM mapping is never the expected oracle.
notation.identityAttributes: Renderer-owned element rows also have generated id and data-editor-node. Capture actual id/attribute values once and compare; never invent serial values or accept copied attributes as authority. Mark-only wrappers have their literal static attrs and no independent model row id.
notation.attrs: Only listed static attrs asserted; separately captured generated identity attrs remain present. Host role/locale/aria label do not create document payload.
notation.textOwnership: D02 explicitly replaces actual Text in a controlled driver, not real UA/native input. Old Text may retire during UA; outer/mark/outside survival and zero adapter remounts are independent assertions.
notation.finalPaths: Expected final raw paths are authored here and apply to the committed rendered literal; interim UA may keep an explicitly observed suffix wrapper until authoritative affected reconciliation.
notation.outside: H/O objects and metadata are unchanged while their root child index may change after removal of selected siblings; this is actual object identity, not equal text alone.
notation.baseline: After legitimate native selection setup. State-only selection/marks/barrier changes are asserted separately from zero document/undo claims.

limits.budgetMeaning: Inclusive; charge before copying/traversal, globally across an observation. Every scene is an entry, BR/mark wrappers are nodes. Original/current text fields each obey the cap; legacy LF diagnostic separators also charged. Native/transport budgets may refuse earlier.
